description: This file defines several data models related to a finance tracker application, including classes for budget summaries, categorized items, and trend points for charting. Each class includes factory methods for JSON deserialization.

classes.name: BudgetSummary
classes.description: Represents aggregate financial data including total income, total expense, and balance.

classes.name: ByCategoryItem
classes.description: Represents aggregated financial data filtered by category, including the type (income or expense).

classes.name: TrendPoint
classes.description: Represents periodized financial data points used for charting, including start date, income, and expense.

methods.name: BudgetSummary.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a BudgetSummary instance from JSON data.

methods.name: ByCategoryItem.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ByCategoryItem instance from JSON data.

methods.name: TrendPoint.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a TrendPoint instance from JSON data.
